items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I became the seventh man in the John Kirby band, and that was because Buster Bailey and Kirby had had an argument... you better call Budd Johnson. So Charler Shavers and Kirby called me to come down and replace Buster Bailey.

ctx.x: You know. And -- (Inaudible) ball systems then?

Oh, yes. We was playing band systems. I started out on Albert, though, you know. But -- in high school, the high school days. I played Albert. And, then, of course, when Boehm became popular, you know, and -- and everybody jumped to Boehm. But, all of the old masters like Buster Bailey and --
